Applicant
 V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra ...

Respondent
 Mr. Drupad Patil with Mr. Dheeraj Patil for the
 applicant.

Mr. Pandurang H. Gaikwad, App for the
 respondent/State.

DATED : JUNE 20, 2023  P.C.:
1. Leave to amend. Amendment to be carried out forthwith.

2. Issue notice to the respondent no.2, returnable on 17 July 2023.
3.

Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.238 of 2023 registered with Karveer Police Station, Kolhapur for offence punishable under section 376, 376(2)(n), 354-A, 313, 323, 504, 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 the applicant has filed present anticipatory bail application seeking relief under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
4. On perusal of the report and material on record, it appears that the alleged incidents are between 28 October 2022 to 902-aba1701-2023.doc February 2023.
According to the informant, the applicant forced her to abort.

Considering the period of incidents alleged and the material on record,

1 prima facie case is made out.
